title: Preview-selection bias probe: role label vs. scene position (experiment brief)
purpose: Falsifiable experiment brief testing whether model-judge "clickability" preferences in the Task 1 Preview evaluation (arXiv 2609.12769v3) track narrative role labels or are confounded by scene position. Includes JSONL fixtures, judge prompt template, and observation sheet. Not executed; no footage required.
